page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.13xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 52 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating hyperthreading resource contention.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware configuration offers a balanced resource profile suitable for enterprise applications, mid-sized databases, containerized microservices, and general-purpose web serving. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance, making it a reliable choice for workloads that require predictable processing power without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances.
